technical_and_design_decisions: Work is performed on the existing open-source Spring XD codebase (Spring Integration / Spring for Apache Hadoop / Kafka message bus based), using its established module, stream DSL, and admin/REST endpoint architecture; no migration to Spring Framework 6 / Java 17 is in scope for this increment.
U1: Remove the module list from BaseDefinition and lazily re-parse the DSL text on demand via the existing StreamParser, keeping the change backward compatible with persisted stream definitions.

U2: Implement reliable HDFS writes by extending the existing HDFS sink (Spring for Apache Hadoop) with commit acknowledgement callbacks propagated back over the message bus, plus configuration options (e.g., enable/timeout/retry) and metrics.
U3: Expose the partition key/expression as an overridable option on source and processor modules, resolved via SpEL against the message at runtime and passed to the message bus partition strategy.
U4: Extend the Kafka message bus consumer configuration to support subscribing to a list of topic-partitions and merging them into the single inbound queue/channel of the module.

U5: Extend the existing XD DSL parser into a context-aware parser endpoint that accepts prior stream definitions (symbol table) so partially parsed streams (as sent by the Flo UI) can be validated, including module/option value checks.

U6: Produce a design document (spike) only: module colocation, classloader isolation, lifecycle and transport implications of deploying a whole stream in a single container; no production code delivered.
U7: Centralize handling of non-default ConfigurableConversionService instances in the tuple serialization/deserialization path so custom conversion services survive Kryo/serialization round-trips.
U8: Build a small repeatable benchmark harness (JMH-style or load-injection script) around a representative stream, run it with JMX enabled and disabled, and publish a results document.
Testing uses the existing Spring XD test infrastructure: JUnit unit tests, Spring integration tests, and embedded/local Kafka and HDFS (mini-cluster) fixtures for integration tests.
All code changes go through the standard GitHub fork/branch + pull request code review process before merge.
assumptions: One experienced developer (the estimator) performs all work; estimates are effort in workdays (1 workday = 8 productive hours), not calendar duration.
The developer has full access to the Spring XD source code, build system, CI pipeline, and existing test fixtures, including local/embedded Kafka and HDFS mini-clusters.
The referenced branch for U1 exists and contains the prior XD-2877 groundwork.
Scope is limited to the eight user stories; each includes design, implementation, unit/integration testing, and minimal user/developer documentation as appropriate.
U6 is a design-and-documentation spike only; implementation of single-container deployment is out of scope.
U8 requires creating a lightweight benchmark harness but no new infrastructure procurement.
Estimates exclude project management, release management, production deployment, and ongoing maintenance.
No external blockers (e.g., unavailable reviewers, environment outages) are included; code review effort of the author is included, reviewer effort is excluded.

activities.activity_name: U1 - Analyze and design BaseDefinition refactor
activities.activity_description: Review the existing branch and BaseDefinition usage, identify all consumers of the module list, and design the lazy re-parse approach.

activities.activity_name: U1 - Implement BaseDefinition module-list removal with on-demand reparse
activities.activity_description: Refactor BaseDefinition to remove the persisted module list and reparse the DSL text as needed; update all affected callers.

activities.activity_name: U1 - Unit and integration tests for refactor
activities.activity_description: Add/update tests covering stream definition parsing, equality, persistence round-trips, and regression tests for affected components.

activities.activity_name: U2 - Design reliable HDFS write acknowledgements
activities.activity_description: Design commit-acknowledgement flow from HDFS sink back over the message bus, including options (timeout, retry), failure semantics, and metrics.

activities.activity_name: U2 - Implement reliable HDFS writes for stream pipelines
activities.activity_description: Extend the HDFS sink with commit callbacks/sync semantics, configuration options, and acknowledgement propagation.
Unit tests plus integration tests against an HDFS mini-cluster, including failure/timeout scenarios and option validation.

activities.activity_name: U3 - Implement partition function override in source/processor modules
activities.activity_description: Add an overridable partition key/expression option resolved via SpEL and wired into the message bus partitioning strategy.
Unit and integration tests verifying custom partition expressions route messages to the expected partitions, including default behavior.

activities.activity_name: U4 - Implement consumption from multiple topic-partitions
activities.activity_description: Extend the Kafka message bus consumer to subscribe to multiple topic-partitions and merge them into a single inbound queue/channel.
Integration tests against embedded Kafka verifying consumption from several partitions through a single queue, ordering expectations, and configuration validation.

activities.activity_name: U5 - Design context-aware DSL parser endpoint
activities.activity_description: Design parser API changes to accept known stream definitions as context so Flo's partial parses (e.g., taps referencing previously defined streams) validate correctly, including module/option value checks.

activities.activity_name: U5 - Implement new DSL parser for Flo integration
activities.activity_description: Implement incremental/context-aware parsing, symbol resolution across streams, and validation of module/option values with clear error reporting.

activities.activity_name: U5 - Test DSL parser and endpoint
activities.activity_description: Unit tests for parser grammar/validation and endpoint tests covering the Flo partial-parse scenarios and error messages.

activities.activity_name: U6 - Design and document single-container stream deployment
activities.activity_description: Investigate and document the approach for colocating all modules of a stream in one container: classloading, lifecycle, transport bypass, configuration, and trade-offs.

activities.activity_name: U7 - Uniform handling of non-default ConfigurableConversionService in tuples
activities.activity_description: Centralize conversion-service handling so custom services are not reset after tuple deserialization; includes regression tests for serialization round-trips.

activities.activity_name: U8 - Benchmark stream with and without JMX and document results
activities.activity_description: Set up a repeatable benchmark harness for a representative stream, run with JMX enabled and disabled, analyze throughput/latency differences, and write the findings document.

activities.activity_name: Cross-cutting - Code review, rework and integration
activities.activity_description: Author-side pull request preparation, addressing review feedback, rebasing branches, and resolving integration conflicts across the eight stories.

activities.activity_name: Cross-cutting - Final documentation and build/CI verification
activities.activity_description: Update reference docs/release notes for new options and behaviors, and verify the full CI build and test suite pass for the increment.
